title: Furry, Guns & Changed
description: This is a complete modded build, where you'll encounter a post-apocalyptic atmosphere, new biomes, and challenging gameplay conditions.
body:
## This world is teeming with changed monsters. And you will either become one of them or fight back with firearms and melee weapons.
**This build is a post-apocalyptic world that is close to the lore of "changed". Now, in addition to zombies and skeletons, latex monsters pose a serious threat, as they will consume not only you but also the previously mentioned zombies and skeletons, creating a massive army that can cause a lot of problems.**![dark latex laboratory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5de7332ce37036a307969fb5bff41a5b36271198.png)

**Explore the world, create weapons, and immerse yourself in the study of latex.**
![Yufeng near the underground laboratory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/161b7576b878189659b597a5e4cee0f9d23006a5.png)
This is my first project, and I'm still learning all the details and mechanics, but I really enjoy working on it. If you want to contact me, please send an email to **furrygunschanged@gmail.com**

The project is being actively developed, and there are ideas for future updates, but your suggestions can also influence the project's progress.
